svg.aria-label: Dive log for the last 365 days: 116 metres down at one metre per contribution, the sunlit zone. 31 active days, longest streak 4 days, longest break 80 days, 3 followers, 0 stars, 1 years on GitHub. Languages: TypeScript 33%, Jupyter Notebook 22%, Python 14%, JavaScript 9%, HTML 9%.
